summary: Bean Pot: operator site has no rates, but its ResNexus page rendered headless (contrary to the 'ResNexus refuses' lesson): $58 full-hookup / $48 30-A water-electric pull-throughs (Nov 2026), 45-75 ft; hookups, dump, store confirmed; booking platform operator (ResNexus). Price gate passes on the $48 site (and Good Sam 10% takes $58 to $52.20).
flags: PRICE GATE passes: cheapest real RV night $48 (30-amp water/electric pull-through, sites 38/39). The full-hookup sites are $58; the stored Good Sam Park flag (10% off) brings that to $52.20, still over $50, so the pass rests on the W/E sites.
RESNEXUS: the booking page rendered in a headless browser (one load, default dates, no clicks) - it listed every site with its Standard Rate. Only one date (2026-11-25) read; summer rates not read.
FACILITIES: laundry (note-derived) not mentioned anywhere on the operator site; left as stored, not confirmed. Showers not stated (the site says 'clean bathhouse' only).
SEASON: no season stated; the engine sells nights in late November, so not obviously seasonal - season left empty.
Google 4.5 over 414 reviews; RV Life 4*/$$. Nightly by design (ResNexus nightly sites); no long-stay signals on the site.
